description: Entry point for building a court website scraper end to end. It coordinates the site analyst, the script generator and the executor, and runs the generate, test and repair loop until the scraper works.
inputs: court site URL | use case and case type | extraction schema (fields to collect) | optional onboarding notes, previous script, error history
outputs: a working, tested scraper script | a live step-by-step plan of the run
use_when: you want to onboard a new court website and get a working scraper automatically | you need the full pipeline: analyze the site, generate the script, test it, fix it | you don't know which scraper step you need and want it handled end to end
not_for: only studying a website's structure -> SiteAnalyst | only writing the script -> ScrapeGenerator | only running an existing script -> ScrapeExecutor | fixing a scraper that already fails in production -> ScrapeMonitor
keywords: court scraper | onboard court site | build scraper | end to end scraping | scraper pipeline

description: Explores a court website on its own and writes a site briefing: how login works, how search works, blockers like captchas, navigation steps and where each field is on the page.
inputs: court site URL | court name | sample case numbers or person names | extraction schema
outputs: a site briefing report for building a scraper
use_when: you want to understand how a court website works before scraping it | you need to know if a court site has login, captcha or other blockers | you want to find where case fields appear on a court site
not_for: writing the scraper script -> ScrapeGenerator | running the full scraper build -> ScraperOrchestrator
keywords: analyze website | court site structure | site briefing | captcha | navigation flow | login check

description: Navigates a court website from a case number to the case-detail page and writes a reusable, self-contained scraper script that can then be run at scale.
inputs: court site URL | sample case numbers or person name | extraction schema | optional site analysis, previous script, error history
outputs: a reusable scraper script
use_when: you need a scraper script for a court website | you want code that goes from a case number to the case-detail page | you need to regenerate a script because the old one broke
not_for: running an existing script -> ScrapeExecutor | just studying the site -> SiteAnalyst | the full analyze-generate-test loop -> ScraperOrchestrator
keywords: generate scraper | write scraper script | scraping code | case detail page | automation script

description: Runs an already-generated court scraper script to pull case details, for one case or a batch. Uses no AI at run time.
inputs: scraper script | court site URL | case number or person name | optional batch CSV of cases
outputs: extracted case-detail fields, or the error
use_when: you already have a working scraper and want to run it on cases | you need case details for a list of case numbers from a CSV | you want to run a scraper at scale
not_for: creating a new scraper script -> ScrapeGenerator | fixing a scraper that keeps failing -> ScrapeMonitor | the full analyze-generate-test pipeline -> ScraperOrchestrator
keywords: run scraper | execute script | case details | batch scrape | court case lookup

description: Checks the quality of a scraper run. It acts as a judge and grades whether the extracted result meets the mission: met, partially met, or not met, with a reason.
inputs: extracted result | raw page text | mission and extraction schema | run details (script ran ok, fields found)
outputs: a verdict: met / partial / not met, with a reason
use_when: you want to verify that a scraper pulled the right data | you need to grade a scraper test or repair attempt | you want to know if the extracted case fields are complete and correct
not_for: running the scraper -> ScrapeExecutor | fixing a failing scraper -> ScrapeMonitor | testing web applications with recorded UI scripts -> ACT Agent
keywords: verify scraper output | grade extraction | quality check | LLM judge | validate result

description: Diagnoses a court scraper that keeps failing, using its errors and failure screenshots. Decides whether regenerating the script will help or whether the cause is anti-bot blocking or a temporary issue, and if useful, regenerates the script.
inputs: failing scraper's errors and screenshots
outputs: a diagnosis | a fresh, regenerated script when re-authoring helps
use_when: your court scraper keeps failing and you don't know why | a scraper broke after the court website changed | you want to know if failures are caused by anti-bot blocking
not_for: building a scraper for a new site -> ScraperOrchestrator | grading one scraper result -> QAAgent
keywords: scraper failing | broken scraper | fix scraper | diagnose errors | anti-bot | repair script

description: Classifies court cases from PACER. Takes a CSV of cases, processes them in batches, collects and annotates the case documents, and classifies each case for legal discovery.
inputs: CSV file of cases | batch size and batch name
outputs: classified cases | annotated case PDFs
use_when: you have a list of PACER cases and need each one classified | you want to process many federal court cases in batches | you need case documents annotated for legal discovery
not_for: building a scraper for a court website -> ScraperOrchestrator | running a scraper to pull case details -> ScrapeExecutor
keywords: PACER | case classification | legal discovery | federal court cases | PDF annotation | batch cases
